    Finite decompositions and objectwise vanishing #

    These elementary lemmas are shared by the incoming-Hom locality proof and by the older control-window development. They require neither a control window nor a finite quotient.

        If every displayed indecomposable summand of a finite decomposition vanishes on a deleted object set, then so does the decomposed module.
